description: Beta, for models that are not on the tracked list. Give any public Hugging Face repo: the 4-bit GGUF file is read from its file listing (or from its most downloaded GGUF build), and the answer gives the memory the model needs and the fit verdict per machine. File size is measured, the context cache is computed from the config of the repo or of the model it was made from, the runtime share is an assumption. When the shape cannot be read the verdict is UNKNOWN and only the file size is given. No speed figures. Limits: 20 calls per hour per caller, 40 new repos per hour in all; a reading is reused for 24 hours. For tracked models find_fit has no such limit.

context.description: Context length in tokens (default 8192); capped at the model's own window.

hardware.description: One hardware id, e.g. rtx-3060-12gb. Without it the verdict is given for every machine on the list.

repo.description: The repo as "owner/name", e.g. TheDrummer/Cydonia-24B-v4.1, or its huggingface.co link.

name: measure_model
title: Measure any Hugging Face model (beta)
